title: Phase and Project Validation and Close Workspace Definition

sharedRule.validationPurpose: Review the durable document population and record the Operator closure decision and rationale.
sharedRule.closePurpose: Execute an Approved closeout decision without requiring a second approval.
sharedRule.closeEvidence: Approved closeout document with closureDecision Close

entryRequirements: Approved Validation_Record for every required Formal Work Card
Every remaining candidate explicitly resolved, deferred, superseded, already satisfied, or carried forward
reviewPopulation: Applicable observations, risks, decisions, and evidence
phase.completionRule: Phase Close completes when Phase_Closeout is Approved and closureDecision is Close.

entryRequirements: Approved Project Profile and Project Roadmap
Approved Phase Closeout for every required mapped phase
Remaining project work explicitly resolved, deferred, transferred, or documented as a known limitation
reviewPopulationGroups: Phase planning and Work Card records
Project-level observations, risks, decisions, and unresolved items
project.completionRule: Project Close completes when Project_Closeout is Approved and closureDecision is Close.

prohibitedArchitecture: Separate phase or project closeout approval artifacts
Separate validation-complete or close-complete authority records
Route tokens, role gates, approval queues, execution runs, hashes, or decision timelines
Repeated Work Card testing during Phase or Project Validation
